newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha develops new piston technology.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha develops new piston technology.

text.p: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it developed the world's first technology to mass produce a light-weight forged aluminium engine piston.
Currently, most conventional engines use cast aluminium pistons, except for motor racing engines which use hand-made pistons.
Yamaha said the new engine piston, called Powder Metal-Piston (PM-P), is 20 percent lighter than conventional pistons and has two to 2.5-fold tensile strength compared with the cast type.

Yamaha plans to produce fewer than 100,000 of the new pistons a year for the time being, but production is likely to increase rapidly in the near future, managing director Ryuichi Yamashita told reporters.
